title: Friendly Airports for Mothers Improvement Act
official_summary:
Friendly Airports for Mothers Improvement Act

This bill requires small hub airports to maintain a lactation area for nursing mothers and a baby changing table in at least one men's and one women's restroom in each passenger terminal building of the airport.

Currently, medium and large hub airports must comply with this requirement by FY2021. The bill requires small hub airports to be in compliance by FY2023.

summary.headline: Requires small U.S. airports to provide nursing areas and baby changing tables in their terminals by fiscal year 2023.
summary.what_it_does: This law requires small hub airports to keep a lactation area for nursing mothers in each passenger terminal building. It also requires a baby changing table in at least one men's restroom and one women's restroom in each terminal. Medium and large hub airports already had to meet this requirement by fiscal year 2021, and this law sets a 2023 deadline for small hub airports.

who_it_affects.how: They must add or maintain nursing areas and baby changing tables in their passenger terminals by fiscal year 2023.

who_it_affects.group: Nursing mothers and parents traveling with babies
who_it_affects.how: They can expect a private nursing area and changing tables at small hub airports once the requirement is met.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Small hub airports must comply by fiscal year 2023. Medium and large hub airports were required to comply by fiscal year 2021.
